messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — service=edge-proxy, symptom=5xx/timeouts, detected at 2026-03-15T21:10Z. Pager: @sre-jin. Please ack with /ack.

sre-jin: acked. I'm oncall. Paging full incident channel.

maria: seeing a large spike in 502/504 from envoy on host pool shard-east-1 — rolling 5m error rate ~18%.

devops-ryan: confirmed, graph: https://grafana.redwood/company/edge-proxy/errors (link) — spike started ~20:58Z.

sre-jin: impact: a subset of requests to /v1/generate are getting 502s, customer reports latency/timeouts. CS notified.

customer-success-sam: ping — started getting support tickets from AcmeCorp in eu-west. They're seeing 5xx starting ~20:58 UTC.

eng-lead-anya: any recent deploys to LB or route rules? I didn't push anything in last hour.

infra-jen: I deployed a route weight change 20:50 UTC to shift traffic for canary — checking rollback history.

sre-jin: can you paste the LB config snippet you changed?

infra-jen: here's the per-route fragment I applied:
```
route:
  match: /v1/generate
  retry_policy:
    retry_on: 5xx,connect,refused-stream
    num_retries: 2
  route_action:
    weighted_clusters:
      clusters:
        - name: generate-v2
          weight: 80
        - name: generate-v1
          weight: 20
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    max_connections: 1000
```

sre-jin: interesting — num_retries=2 + retry_on 5xx could amplify 5xx from a misrouted cluster leading to cascades. Also circuit breaker max_connections low for bursty model workers.

devops-ryan: logs from envoy show repeated 503s with upstream reset: "upstream reset" and a lot of 503 response_codes. sample:
```
[envoy] 2026-03-15T21:05:12Z upstream reset: connection closed
[envoy] 2026-03-15T21:06:03Z response_code: 503 cluster: generate-v2
```

sre-jin: next steps — immediate mitigations to reduce customer impact:
- set route.retry_policy.num_retries = 0 for /v1/generate
- increase circuit_breaker thresholds for generate-v2 cluster
- shift 100% traffic to generate-v1 (known healthy) while we investigate
- pause canary weight change

eng-lead-anya: I'll coordinate the rollback. infra-jen can you revert the route fragment and set num_retries: 0? If you want I can apply with /deploy rollback.

infra-jen: rolling back and applying patch now.

deploy-bot: starting rollout: revert-route-fragment to prod (id: r-77b)

sre-jin: applying temporary cluster override to nudge traffic: setting weight generate-v2=0 generate-v1=100

infra-jen: patch applied, retry_policy.num_retries=0 and weights updated. Confirming config push to all edge proxies.

devops-ryan: seeing error rate drop to ~6% within 60s. Latency improving.

maria: still seeing some lingering 502s from older connections — envoy needs gradual drain. We should trigger a graceful connection drain on affected proxies.

sre-jin: plan: 1) keep traffic on v1; 2) increase circuit_breaker thresholds on v2 and remove aggressive retry_on for now; 3) schedule controlled canary reintroduce after health check.

infra-jen: circuit_breaker thresholds increased: max_connections=5000, max_pending_requests=2000 (applied).

sre-jin: can we get a dump of upstream pod logs for generate-v2 around the error windows? @eng-lead-anya can you ask model infra to grab logs and resource metrics?

eng-lead-anya: pinged model infra. They reported OOM kills at 20:52 UTC on a few pods — memory pressure + connections likely caused resets.

customer-success-sam: AcmeCorp reports degraded but improving. Posting on status page: "Partial outage for /generate, mitigation in progress". I'll update every 15 minutes.

sre-jin: handoff: I'm the primary until 21:30Z. After that @eng-lead-anya will take over for postmortem and rollback review. If anyone is paged, escalate to @oncall-lead.

maria: saved the relevant metrics dashboards and screenshots: https://grafana.redwood/company/d/abcd

sre-jin: root cause hypothesis: recent route weight shift sent majority traffic to generate-v2 which had resource regressions; combined with retries and tight circuit breaker thresholds caused retry amplification and upstream resets -> 5xx cascade.

eng-lead-anya: action items for post-incident:
- postmortem doc with timeline + deploy diff
- add guardrail: block route weight >50% unless health checks pass
- add automated check to prevent retry_on 5xx on certain routes
- improve pod OOM alerts

infra-jen: created incident ticket INC-2026-324. Linking logs and config diffs.

sre-jin: closing updates: 5xx rate back to baseline ~0.7%. Keeping monitor for 30m. If stable, we'll transition to follow-up.

customer-success-sam: updated AcmeCorp: mitigation applied, we're monitoring.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: revert-route-fragment (r-77b) finished.

eng-lead-anya: assigning postmortem owner: @maria. Expect initial draft in 24h.

sre-jin: thanks all. Closing thread once monitors green for 30m.
